description.value:
The crimson eyes of your bloodline have opened. The Sharingan lets you read the flow of a foe's movement and the shape of their chakra, copying jutsu and predicting strikes with eerie accuracy.

You gain the Sharingan Awakened ancestry feature, granting initial dōjutsu benefits. Additional Sharingan tomoe are unlocked by later clan feats. TODO: codify tomoe progression in a separate feat chain.
